records.label: Masculine presentation
records.visual_function: Make the subject read as masculine through structure, proportion, and grooming choices, so the read survives a change of wardrobe and framing.
records.prompt: Give the subject a masculine presentation carried by structure: a broader shoulder-to-hip relationship, squarer jaw and brow planes, a lower-set center of visual weight, and grooming that follows the same anatomy.
invariants: the masculine read comes from anatomy and proportion
structure stays consistent across poses and crops
the presentation coheres with the subject's species and build
misreadings_to_avoid: coded accessories doing all the gender work
exaggerated proportions that break the chosen build
facial structure fighting the stated presentation

records.label: Feminine presentation
records.visual_function: Make the subject read as feminine through structure, proportion, and grooming choices, so the read survives a change of wardrobe and framing.
records.prompt: Give the subject a feminine presentation carried by structure: a narrower shoulder-to-hip relationship, softer jaw and brow planes, a higher-set center of visual weight, and grooming that follows the same anatomy.
invariants: the feminine read comes from anatomy and proportion
structure stays consistent across poses and crops
the presentation coheres with the subject's species and build
misreadings_to_avoid: coded accessories doing all the gender work
facial structure fighting the stated presentation

records.label: Androgynous presentation
records.visual_function: Hold the subject's gender deliberately unresolved through balanced structure, proportion, and grooming, so both reads stay equally available.
records.prompt: Give the subject an androgynous presentation carried by balance: a shoulder-to-hip relationship midway between reads, facial planes that mix soft and squared cues, and grooming chosen to keep the read genuinely open.
invariants: both gender reads stay equally available
the ambiguity is deliberate balance, held by fully authored detail
the presentation coheres with the subject's species and build
misreadings_to_avoid: one strong gendered cue that collapses the ambiguity
inconsistency across views that reads as error
concealment used instead of balanced structure
